text:
maya: starting fractional handoff to router image v2.7 at 2025-09-15T21:00Z. planned weights 5% -> 25% over 15m. tagging @ops-oncall for drain window. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.7

deploy-bot: schedule created: rollout id r-20250915-1423, starting 1739999999. steps: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. @maya to confirm.

ben: confirm. quick heads-up: earlier canaries saw p95 spike ~80ms -> 180ms at 25% in perf-lab.

kai: thanks for flag. what's rollback threshold? default is p95 + 2x baseline or errors >0.5% for 5m.

maya: set rollback thresholds: p95 increase >1.8x baseline OR 5xx >0.75% sustained 3m -> abort and pin to v2.6. everyone ok? :eyes: 

sarah: ok. ops, please prepare router weight change CLI in case we need fast revert.

ops-oncall: prepped. quick commands:
```
routerctl set-weight --service frontend --version v2.6 --weight 100
routerctl drain-connections --service frontend --version v2.7 --timeout 120
```
I'll be ready at T+10m.

deploy-bot: rollout step 1 (5%) applied @1739999999.

ben: seeing 5% looks fine.

ben: 10m into ramp p95 creeping: 110ms -> 150ms but error rate 0.02% - still under threshold.

kai: increase sampling for traces. toggling full traces on v2.7 for next 5m.

maya: hold next step til T+20m to observe. hold reason: early latency trend. cancel auto-advance.

deploy-bot: auto-advance disabled per @maya.

sarah: ops, if we decide to rollback, prefer pinning router to v2.6 then scale down v2.7. don't want live flip.

ops-oncall: on it. will pin BGP/routing on edge LB if needed.

ben: after extra sampling, found hotspot in attention kernel path on long prompts. probable model compilation mismatch with kernel selector.

maya: decision call: we will abort the ramp. action: set weights back to 100% v2.6, drain v2.7, and open rollback ticket. Can someone trigger quick pin?

ops-oncall: executing:
routerctl set-weight --service frontend --version v2.6 --weight 100
routerctl set-weight --service frontend --version v2.7 --weight 0
routerctl drain-connections --service frontend --version v2.7 --timeout 300
done at 1740000055

deploy-bot: rollout r-20250915-1423 marked ABORTED at 1740000060 by maya. reason: p95 regression during ramp.

maya: filing rollback ticket: RW-5023. added release notes note: "aborted: kernel mismatch for long prompt paths; will revert and prepare regression test."

kai: I'll coordinate with ML infra to produce a kernel-safe build and create a canary with heavy long-prompt workload.

sarah: we should also add a postmortem blurb on the console for affected routes + update CI eval set.

maya: thanks all. re-schedule tentative re-rollout 2025-09-18 22:00Z after infra patch and perf-tests.

ops-oncall: ack. will reserve change window.

ben: noted. will follow up on perf benchmarks.
